ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70% high-intensity white to 30% low-intensity black pixel distribution across the visible ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve sweeping from the central notch toward the distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertical dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the right lobe; thin diagonal dark-pixel scratches on the upper-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle colonization on both distal tips, causing significant texture disruption and pigment contrast.
